content.text:
I couldn't escalate or send anything: my tools can only read tickets, search, and classify text. Below are the escalation note and the customer reply draft, ready to paste into your systems.

**Escalation note for billing/refunds (t007, priority: urgent)**

- **Issue:** Customer reports a $120 annual-plan charge after cancelling in March. They say they have a cancellation confirmation email and will dispute with their bank if not reversed today.
- **Not verified:** I have not confirmed the cancellation date, the charge date, or the account's subscription history. The ticket text is the customer's claim only.
- **Dispute risk:** Chargeback threatened. Please review before the customer's stated deadline.
- **Related tickets:** t042 (cancelled two weeks ago, charged again, "take the money back") may show a similar pattern and is worth checking together.
- **Routing issue:** The automated classifier labeled this "Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports" with low confidence (0.23). That label is wrong for a billing dispute. The ticket is already in the billing category, so the label should be ignored or corrected.

**Draft reply to customer**

> Hi,
>
> I'm sorry for the frustration. Being charged for an annual plan after you cancelled in March is a serious problem, and I understand why you want it fixed quickly.
>
> I've passed your ticket to our billing team with your cancellation confirmation details. They will check your account history and the charge against your cancellation. I can't confirm the outcome or a timeline yet, and I don't want to promise something before that review is done.
>
> Please keep the confirmation email you mentioned, and don't close any dispute with your bank until you've heard back from our billing team, so we can work on this together.
>
> Thank you for your patience.
